info.title: v2.product.add_model
info.description: Add model. More detail please check: https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/219

post.description: Add model. More detail please check: https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/219

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: Days to ship. Please get the days_to_ship range from the get_dts_limit API.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: The dimension of this model. If don't set the dimension of this model, will use the dimension of item by default.

parameters.name: gtin_code
parameters.description: - GTIN is an identifier for trade items, developed by the international organization GS1. - They have 8 to 14 digits. The most common are UPC, EAN, JAN and ISBN. - GTIN will help boost positioning in online marketing channels like Google and Facebook. - That incorporation with GTIN will also aid in Search and Recommendation in Shopee itself allowing buyers to have higher likelihood of finding one's listing. Note: If you want to set “Item without GTIN”, please pass the gtin_code as "00". The validation rule is based on the value return in gtin_validation_rule" field in v2.product.get_item_limit API - Mandatory: This field is required and must contain a correctly formatted GTiN number. - Flexible: This field is required and must contain either a correctly formatted GTlN number or "00" to declare that the item/model has no valid GTlN. - Optional: This field is optional and can contain a correctly formatted GTiN number, "00" or be omitted entirely.

parameters.name: is_pre_order
parameters.description: Whether the model is pre order.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: ID of item

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: location id, you can get the location id from v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail api, if seller don't have any warehouse, you don't need to upload this field.

parameters.name: model_list
parameters.description: Model list

parameters.name: model_sku
parameters.description: Seller sku, model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters.

parameters.name: original_price
parameters.description: Normal stock for price

parameters.name: package_height
parameters.description: The height of package for this model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_length
parameters.description: The length of package for this model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_width
parameters.description: The width of package for this model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pre_order
parameters.description: Pre-order information of this model. Notes: If don't set the DTS of this model, will use the DTS of the item by default.

parameters.name: seller_stock
parameters.description: new stock info for model（Please notice that stock(including Seller Stock and Shopee Stock) should be larger than or equal to real-time reserved stock）

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: stock
parameters.description: stock

parameters.name: tier_index
parameters.description: Tier index of model

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: The weight of this model, the unit is KG. If don't set the weight of this model, will use the weight of item by default. If set the dimension of this model, them must set the weight of this model.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/add_model?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "model_list": [
        {
            "gtin_code": "-",
            "model_sku": "SKU",
            "original_price": 38.3,
            "seller_stock": [
                {
                    "location_id": "-",
                    "stock": 0
                }
            ],
            "weight": 1.1
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
